name: config-command
body: Config command: the `kalide config` CLI surface — the handler that parses `get|set|unset|list`, accepts recognised keys only (the recognised key set is `default-template-dir`; a key outside it is a usage error listing the recognised keys, exit 2), reads and writes the user config through the user-config store, prints the value or the set-recognised-key list to stdout and errors to stderr, and returns the process status code (0 success, non-zero on an unset key, 2 on a usage error). It is dispatched by `cli.Run` beside init, init-library, start, templates, upgrade and version, and is the CLI presentation half of domain.service.load-user-config. Its intended home is a new internal/cli file (config.go, handler runConfig and its helpers); the code is built by the plan.
